name: framefusion
description: FrameFusion: AI short-form video studio (Django API + Vite web app)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:web && npm run setup:api
scripts.migrate: node scripts/run-api-tool.mjs manage upgrade_single_user && node scripts/run-api-tool.mjs manage migrate
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run lint:api && node scripts/run-api-tool.mjs ruff format --check . && npm run typecheck:api && npm run check:migrations && npm run test:api
